content:
# A Massive Change and a Fair Go

## A whole system overview and an invitation to Paul Bishop

Paul,

I remember meeting you at Bruce Mau's State Library of Queensland visit in November 2011. I was exploring disaster resilience after the south-east Queensland floods. You interviewed me with your video recorder. That conversation sits near the beginning of a much longer period of investigating how our systems work and designing alternatives.

This wiki brings that work together and opens a practical conversation about its local leadership. My main invitation is for you to help carry the Redlands expression of the programme, convene the people who want to develop it, and explore a working relationship that gives the work continuity while I develop the wider architecture and network.

I have thought seriously about the possible short mayoral term if a vacancy leads to a by-election. I believe there is substance here for a winning public case. Earning that mandate would involve real organising and public scrutiny. My preference is to preserve the freedom to research, create, travel, earn a living and build the wider relationships. A good local handover would put that preference into practice.

The proposed partnership also includes a personal invitation to explore Aura Genesis, the intensive programme combining hyperbaric oxygen therapy, reflection and the proposed Truth Engine, and to engage with P4A's civic work. Those invitations are explained in their own chapters. They are significant parts of the conversation, with their own practical arrangements and choices.

## The purpose

Joyful Responsible Abundance is the guiding idea. It asks whether growing capability makes life more worthwhile, whether we take responsibility for its consequences, and whether people share in its benefits.

**Mutual Futures is central.** It connects productive ownership, business succession, learning, income, care and time for life during the AI and automation transition. Around it sit personal intelligence, cooperative work, community computing, cultural production, democratic participation and physical infrastructure.

The long horizon includes underground settlements with the productive systems to support successive generations, shared Earth and space observations, preparation for severe disruptions, and Australia helping countries cooperate across their differences. The proposed GAJRA Earth network connects locally shaped associations through practical work and a continuing inquiry into futures worth inhabiting.

For me, July 2035 is a key point in that long game: Live Aid's 50th anniversary, connected with three days of art, music and public reflection on past, present and future. Brisbane 2032 and Australia's coming sequence of total solar eclipses offer other shared occasions along the way.

## How to read this

Begin with [the invitation](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/The-invitation-to-Paul), then [where we met](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Where-we-met-and-Bruce-Mau), [the whole system](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/The-whole-system) and [Mutual Futures](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Mutual-Futures). Those chapters establish the relationship, purpose and economic architecture.

For the local role, continue through [people and public responsibilities](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/People-and-public-responsibilities), [mayoral options](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Mayoral-options-and-personal-agency) and [making the handover work](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Making-the-handover-work).

For the complete scope, follow the chapter order in the sidebar. The [reading routes and glossary](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Reading-routes-and-glossary) provide shorter paths and explain the unfamiliar terms. The [project directory](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Project-directory) holds the main public links in one place.

## Reading the status of the work

There is a substantial body of published writing, websites, software workbenches, creative work and research. There is also earlier hands-on community work and a number of direct conversations with public representatives. The cooperative, physical installations and wider service network still need their participating people, organisations, resources and agreements. The [current position](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Current-position-and-open-decisions) chapter makes those distinctions explicit.

My account of our first meeting and the other private meetings is personal recollection. Dated public facts have a separate [source register](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents). A proposal is written as a proposal; an established activity has its actual record. Keeping those records clear makes the ambition easier to examine and carry forward.

This is an invitation to discuss responsibility, participation and a workable relationship. It is written so you, other councillors, community members and prospective collaborators have enough context to assess the whole picture.

Luke Nathan Hayes

Minjerribah / North Stradbroke Island, Queensland

Edition: 24 October 2026

title: The invitation to Paul
content:
I am inviting Paul Bishop into a conversation about leading and convening the Redlands expression of a much wider programme. The aim is a lasting local network of people and organisations, with clear responsibilities and useful resources, while my own work continues across the larger architecture.

## Why this is a conversation with Paul

Our first meeting at Bruce Mau's State Library visit gives us a shared point of reference. I was already asking systems questions around the 2011 floods. The years since have added legal research, local cultural work, personal intelligence, ownership models, software, music and proposals for physical infrastructure.

Paul's arts and cultural responsibilities connect with the public communication and creative work. His wider experience in facilitation, cooperative engagement and civic design is relevant to bringing people together around the whole programme. The invitation is to explore that fit in practice. [S07](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s07)

## Three connected invitations

### Carry local leadership

The local work needs someone who enjoys people, discussion, public responsibility and the continuing work of bringing different interests together. That includes hearing reservations, finding willing participants, giving each organisation an understandable role and helping the work move through council and community settings.

Paul would help convene that leadership. Project teams, operating organisations and professional staff would carry their own work. A local programme of this breadth needs several capable people and a way to replace them when their circumstances change.

The first discussion is about appetite and fit: which parts interest him, what he would want to understand, the people he would bring into the conversation, and the resources a real role would require.

### Experience Aura Genesis personally

Aura Genesis is the proposed intensive process for developing the relationship between a person and their personal Aura of Intelligence. Its design combines sixty roughly two-hour sessions in a hyperbaric oxygen therapy chamber with dialogue, observation, reflection and the proposed Truth Engine.

The Truth Engine begins with agreed exercises involving truthful and deliberately false responses. It explores differences between what a person says, believes, feels and does. The person reviews interpretations and corrects the record. Developing and evaluating that capability is part of the research.

My invitation is for Paul to consider becoming a participant and informed collaborator in that development. The practical discussion includes time, suitable clinical delivery, equipment, cost, recording, personal information and the relationship that continues afterwards. The [Aura and Genesis](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Aura-and-Genesis) chapter explains the experience and the four hardware pathways.

This personal invitation belongs in our proposed working relationship. Public access to community activities and civic participation remains available through ordinary routes.

### Engage with P4A

P4A brings legal understanding, public evidence, competing proposals, humour and democratic participation into a common civic workbench. Its Redlands material provides a local setting for exploring the larger approach.

I want to discuss both the practical tools and the broader democratic direction with Paul. Using a public workbench, helping develop the movement and making a future electoral commitment are specific choices. We would identify the actual commitment being considered at each point.

## What I bring

I bring the originating architecture, the published project collection, accumulated research, software and design work, creative material, and relationships developed through local and wider conversations. I also bring a willingness to explain, revise and keep learning.

The material is extensive. Its usefulness depends on people being able to understand it, test it and adapt it to their own setting. The handover therefore includes navigation, working records and time to become familiar with the work. Passing on a set of links is the beginning of that process.

## What I want to preserve

I want an income, a place to live, freedom to travel, time for creative work and room to develop the international network. My continuing local contribution would have an agreed scope, payment where applicable and a practical way to arrange further work.

The architecture also values other people's agency. Each organisation would have its own lawful responsibilities, and people would choose the work and relationships they take on. My authorship and commercial rights, a cooperative's member decisions, a person's private information and cultural authority are different matters with their own agreements.

## What an initial agreement would establish

A useful first agreement would identify the local purpose, the people organising it, the responsibilities Paul is interested in, my continuing contribution, and the resources available. It would also name the unresolved questions and a point at which we review whether the arrangement is working.

There is room to begin with a shared examination of the whole plan and choose practical work from there. The broad ambition stays visible while the actual commitments remain understandable.

The detailed responsibilities, records and handover arrangements are in [making the handover work](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Making-the-handover-work).

title: Where we met and Bruce Mau
content:
The meeting I remember with Paul took place during Bruce Mau's visit to the State Library of Queensland in November 2011. I was investigating disaster resilience after the south-east Queensland floods. Paul interviewed me with his video recorder. I would welcome the chance to find that recording if it survives.

## The event and date

The third annual **Nielson Design Lecture** was held on **Wednesday 23 November 2011**, advertised for 7 pm, in **Auditorium 1 at the State Library of Queensland**, South Brisbane. Mau's **24 Hours to Massive Change** workshop followed on **24-26 November**. Contemporary reporting and the Library Board's annual report establish the visit. [S01](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s01) [S02](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s02) [S03](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s03)

The library has an official recording of Mau's lecture, running 1 hour, 8 minutes and 56 seconds. It is a useful way to return to the room and the ideas of that visit. The recording located during this research is the lecture; the separate interview I remember with Paul remains something to locate. [S01](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s01)

- [Watch the State Library lecture](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-3Zr3dsGq7I).
- [Read the contemporary announcement and interview](https://www.indesignlive.com/articles/bruce-mau-on-massive-change).
- [Read the contemporary account after the lecture](https://www.indesignlive.com/articles/designing-our-future-bruce-mau).

The evidence identifies a lecture and workshop programme. The description of the Brisbane visit in this wiki follows that programme rather than treating it as an installation of the entire original museum exhibition.

## What Massive Change brought into view

The original *Massive Change* book and exhibition grew from work by Bruce Mau, Jennifer Leonard and the Institute without Boundaries. They examined design across systems such as energy, movement, materials, manufacturing, information, cities and living systems. The work widened the question of design beyond the appearance of an individual object. [S04](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s04) [S05](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s05)

One useful implication is that the boundaries of a design problem are themselves a design choice. A transport decision also affects access to work, land use, energy, everyday costs and the conditions for participation. A learning tool affects who gains capability and who owns the resulting knowledge. Those relationships have remained central in my own work.

The Library Board described the Brisbane workshop as the world's first in that named format. It also recorded Mau's discussions with government representatives and work concerning the North Quarter precinct. The visit connected broad ideas with a particular place and a real institutional setting. [S03](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s03)

## The part I carried forward

My interest in resilience was already about relationships between systems. Floods expose the dependence of a household on roads, power, water, communications, food, public information, neighbours and institutions. A useful response brings those connections into view before the next disruption.

That inquiry later widened into law, personal intelligence, ownership, learning, culture and long-term habitats. The scale increased, while the underlying question continued: how do people understand the systems shaping their lives, gain a meaningful say in them, and build greater capability together?

This is the continuity I want to discuss with Paul. The current work is the result of years of development since that first conversation. The proposals in this wiki are my work; the history with Mau provides a shared reference for understanding where the inquiry was heading.

## Questions that keep the idea useful

Large design proposals deserve clear questions about people and power. Who defines the problem? Who carries the cost? Who owns the assets? Who decides? What happens when someone disagrees or leaves? What would count as an improvement?

Those questions shape Mutual Futures, the personal information architecture, the proposed cooperative and the handover itself. They also help distinguish a plan people find exciting from an arrangement they choose to maintain.

## Returning to the conversation

I would like to start with the simple human memory: we met while talking about Massive Change, before Paul's first election to council in 2012. The present invitation is to look at what developed from that period and decide whether there is a worthwhile next chapter together.

The next chapter follows the actual sequence of work, including the later 2012-13 legal reading and the community contributions that were often out of public view.

---

title: The path from 2011 to now
content:
The work has a history longer than the recent websites. Understanding that history helps explain both the scope of the proposal and why much of it has developed quietly.

## 2011 and the systems question

After the south-east Queensland floods, I was investigating disaster resilience and the relationships between people, infrastructure and institutions. The Bruce Mau visit was part of that period. My recollection of meeting Paul belongs here, in November 2011.

The State Library itself had reopened in February 2011 after the floods. The setting was part of the regional experience of disruption and recovery. [S06](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s06)

## The 2012-13 legal reading

The intensive Australian-law reading came later, in late 2012 and the summer of 2012-13. I began with the fine print around my own life: documents, licences, accounts, forms and the legal structures behind them. I gathered and read legislation to understand the rules and institutions I was participating in.

The public archive includes 61 documents, including multiple volumes of major Acts. The significance is the change in how I approached systems: reading their actual terms, tracing their relationships and asking how people might understand and improve them.

The current legal-engine prototype draws on that historical collection. Its development into a maintained contemporary legal service is a separate piece of work. [The P4A chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/P4A-law-and-democratic-participation) explains the distinction and the longer constitutional aim.

## Learning, participation and early interfaces

IChooseInfinity, the Next Great Conversation and Gamify Democracy explored learning, public questions and participation. The Constitutional Matrix of Participation followed in July 2014.

A 2014 account records a visit to The Edge at the State Library to discuss the Verse Box idea. The proposal brought together a public computer interface, conversation, media and shared questions. Today's Verse Box revisits that public introduction through the current Aura architecture. The hardware and software have changed; the interest in making participation understandable has continued.

## Actual local contributions

My 2024 CV records oral-history transcription for the North Stradbroke Island / Minjerribah Historical Museum in 2014. My grandmother, Constance Millar, was alive and involved with the museum during that period. Her contribution to community life is part of my personal connection to the place.

The CV also records Quandamooka Festival website and event work and Island Vibe volunteering in 2015-16. The Island Vibe work included assisting the site manager and the mentor programme. The festival website work extended across three years; I remember receiving about $300 for that contribution.

Those experiences involved cultural records, public communication, events and people learning through participation. They provide practical context for the later media, learning and community-system proposals. The level of public recognition has varied, and much of the work was behind the scenes.

## Aura and the wider architecture

The July 2023 Aura presentation already connected a personal intelligence interface with shared cultural participation and values inquiry. Its gathering proposal used three continuous days organised around past, now and next. That edition targeted an earlier Live Aid anniversary. The current anchor is the 50th anniversary in July 2035. [D01](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

Travel and research in India formed another part of this period. My 2024 CV was prepared after returning to Australia. The public Open Record and Man and Mind pages provide more of the professional, creative and research history.

## The recent body of work

By October 2026 the public collection included personal-intelligence interfaces, civic workbenches, place studies, project and grant tools, media plans, material research, resilience proposals and creative worlds. The Project Atlas helps navigate that collection. A repository creation date identifies a particular software build; it does not establish when the originating idea began.

Most of my current effort has gone into research, software, writing, system design and creative work, often in solitude. Strange But True is the sole-trader identity around that activity. I have not operated the market stalls imagined in some earlier planning material.

Some periods of quiet work also reflected personal circumstances. The relevant point for this handover is that a substantial private development effort now needs relationships, shared understanding and continuing responsibility around it.

## What the history offers the handover

The record gives Paul and other readers specific work to examine: sources, dates, designs, community contributions and successive revisions. It also shows where an idea has persisted through different names and technologies.

The next step in this story is a proposed local leadership arrangement, with work shared among people who want to carry it. My own next chapter includes the wider architecture, income, travel, art, public communication and international relationships.

Public background: [Open Record](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/open-record-luke-nathan-hayes), [Australian law 2012-13](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/australian-law-2012-lukes-relevance/), [Man and Mind](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/luke-nathan-hayes-man-and-mind/) and [Lifetime Memory Map](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/lifetime-memory-map/).

title: The whole system
content:
The whole system connects personal agency with shared productive capacity, public participation and the ability to continue through disruption. Joyful Responsible Abundance gives it a purpose. Mutual Futures is central to the ownership, livelihood and time arrangements through which that purpose enters daily life.

## Begin with a person living one life

A person experiences housing, income, health, learning, family responsibilities, public decisions and technology together. The proposal begins with that lived whole.

Aura of Intelligence is the proposed personal computing environment for organising relevant context and working with AI. Information about a person remains under their chosen permissions. The intended benefit is continuity: an evolving relationship with tools that understand the context the person has actually chosen to provide.

A community also has shared information and work. Public facilities, local businesses, ecosystems, cultural records and council decisions have their own responsibilities. Personal control and shared responsibilities meet through particular agreements and exchanges.

## Ownership and the gains from growing capability

Mutual Futures asks how ownership, learning, income, care and time develop as AI and automation change production. Business succession is one practical route. New enterprises, research and shared infrastructure provide others.

The intended transition includes experienced owners passing on knowledge, younger people gaining real capability, paid learning across different roles and members sharing in productive assets. It also makes room for people who are caring, studying, resting or unable to work.

C-Hours provide a separate record of voluntary human contribution. Financial accounts, employment arrangements and outcomes retain their own records. Recognising care and community work makes those contributions visible while preserving their reciprocal character.

## Shared work, places and computing

Ready S.E.T. Co-op is the proposed work, learning, equipment and shared-service layer. A Cultural Intelligence Node provides a concrete proposal for local computing and skills. Place-based projects provide settings for making, repair, food, culture, housing, care and community life.

The relationships between them matter. A makerspace needs skills, tools, maintenance and useful work. A media network needs people who understand stories, permissions and sources. A computing node needs power, cooling, operators and workloads. Each service becomes more useful when the surrounding relationships are developed with it.

## Public understanding and decisions

The screen and media network is intended to make information, stories, opportunities and disagreement visible in everyday settings. P4A provides a civic workbench for following issues through evidence, law, proposals, public choices and observed results.

The creative work gives people different ways into difficult questions. A film, song or game might open a conversation that a formal report would never reach. Sources and serious discussion remain available behind the public introduction.

## Physical capability and continuity

Transport, energy, water, food, material processing, repair and communications support ordinary life and preparation for disruptions. Their design also affects ownership, employment, ecology and public space.

The longer habitat work explores underground settlements with the productive systems to support successive generations. The Solar Swarm and Sensorium explore observation, modelling and shared scientific inquiry. The same broad programme therefore connects everyday usefulness with severe-disruption scenarios and long-term possibilities.

## The relationships at a glance

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["People and their Auras"] --> B["Shared work and learning"]
    C["Mutual Futures ownership"] --> B
    B --> D["Places and infrastructure"]
    B --> E["Culture and civic participation"]
    D --> F["Resilience and shared science"]
    E --> G["GAJRA Earth cooperation"]
    F <--> G
    E --> A
```

The arrows show intended relationships. The actual people, resources, agreements and operating services are developed through each project.

## Cooperation across places

GAJRA Earth is the proposed Global Association for Joyful Responsible Abundance on Earth. Locally shaped associations would define what those words mean in their own lives, test practical work and share what they learn.

Australia's proposed role in the international programme is to help people and countries cooperate across differences. Shared scientific observation, resilience, learning and peaceful development provide possible common work. Each place keeps its own judgement and responsibilities.

## What joins the parts

The useful common practices are understandable records, source identity, clear permissions, human relationships and ways to correct mistakes. A project record would identify its purpose, people, resources, decisions and results. A personal record would carry its owner's choices. A public statement would carry its evidence and date.

This approach also shapes the handover. Paul would be invited to help convene the Redlands work. Operating organisations and teams would carry their actual responsibilities. My continuing role would be agreed in a way that supports the wider programme and preserves my own agency.

The chapters that follow examine the parts in enough depth to discuss real choices. The directory is there for further exploration, rather than asking every reader to open the entire project collection at once.

title: Mutual Futures
content:
Mutual Futures addresses a question that runs through the whole programme: as AI and automation expand what we can produce, how do people gain a meaningful share of the ownership, income and freedom that follow?

It is the central economic and social proposal in this handover. Personal intelligence, training, public participation and new infrastructure become more useful when people have a secure place in the productive arrangements around them. [The public workbench](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/mutual-futures/) develops that relationship in detail.

## Begin with a whole life

A person needs income, shelter, belonging, useful work, care and room to change direction. These needs occur together. Someone caring for a parent may have little time for a conventional job. A worker whose industry changes may need a paid learning period. A capable young person may need several real experiences before choosing a field. A business owner approaching retirement may want a fair exit and continuity for their staff.

The proposal connects those situations. It explores mutual ownership of productive assets and enterprises, with the benefits supporting livelihoods, learning and time for life. The point of more capable production is a better range of human possibilities.

This brings several ideas into the same system:

| Part | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Productive ownership | Give participating people a durable stake in useful enterprises and assets |
| Business succession | Create a fair transition for an owner and continuity for staff, customers and the community |
| New enterprises | Develop useful work where a service, technology or local capability is missing |
| Paid learning and placements | Let people build capability without treating unpaid availability as the entry requirement |
| Try Everything Once | Offer a range of supported experiences before expecting a permanent life choice |
| Intermittent Retirement | Make periods of rest, caring, exploration or different work possible throughout life |
| Shared services and technology | Improve production while retaining the knowledge and judgement of the people doing the work |

## Succession as a practical starting point

An established local business already has something valuable: working relationships, customers, equipment, practical knowledge and an operating history. A succession arrangement might bring that business into a mutual structure while paying its retiring owner fairly and retaining a paid mentoring role where useful.

This is a detailed commercial and human transition. A sale price, working capital, maintenance, management, debt, staff conditions and customer continuity all affect whether it works. An AI tool does not remove the need to manage a business. An ownership change does not create distributable income by itself.

A useful early case would therefore begin with one willing owner and a business whose position can be examined properly. The participants would compare an ordinary sale, employee or community ownership, and other realistic routes. They would then know what the mutual arrangement adds and what it costs.

The public workbench also explores new enterprises and infrastructure. Succession is one practical route into a wider productive base, rather than the whole model.

## The role of AI and automation

The intention is to use AI, robotics and immersive training to improve useful output and reduce avoidable drudgery. This leaves decisions about ownership and distribution in view. A productivity gain reaches people through wages, prices, services, retained earnings, shared assets, distributions or supported time. Those pathways deserve an explicit agreement.

Existing workers bring knowledge about what actually happens. Involving them in the redesign improves the chance of finding useful changes and identifying hidden costs. Paid training, accessible interfaces and a route to raise concerns belong in the plan alongside the technology.

## Income, contribution and membership

The proposal reaches towards an adequate income and a more generous life. The current work does not establish a universal payment entitlement, a formed investment fund or a final membership constitution. Those are substantive design decisions, with different funding and legal consequences.

C-Hours sit alongside this work as records of freely contributed human time. They have no fixed dollar value and create no claim on a mutual's assets or distributions. Paid work, ownership, money and voluntary contribution retain their own records. [The reciprocity chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/C-Hours-and-reciprocity) explains this important distinction.

## What Paul would help carry

The local invitation is to help bring willing people into a serious conversation about ownership, succession and livelihoods. That includes local businesses, workers, carers, educators, community organisations and people whose present circumstances leave them outside conventional opportunities.

Council has relevant relationships, information and convening capacity. A mutual enterprise would have its own governance, operations and accounts. Any council involvement would have a defined public purpose and the ordinary decisions that apply to public resources.

For an initial working group, the useful questions are concrete: whose life would improve, what productive activity supports that improvement, who owns it, who manages it, and how are the benefits and responsibilities shared? Answering those questions for one credible case would give the larger vision a place to learn.

title: Aura and Genesis
content:
Aura is the personal intelligence layer of the programme. Its purpose is to help a person understand their own life, make sense of information and use increasingly capable AI with continuity, context and choice.

The name covers a broad family of work. An ordinary personal Aura, a public introduction through a Verse Box, the intensive Genesis programme and research into Geode hardware are related parts with different levels of involvement. Keeping those differences clear helps a person choose what they are actually joining.

## An Aura in ordinary life

A personal Aura brings together a person's chosen records, interests, intentions and ways of understanding the world. It might help with learning, remembering, planning, comparing choices or finding a useful connection between projects. The person remains able to correct the interpretation and decide what goes to another person or service.

The interface is broader than a single visual model. Voice, text, lists, familiar screens and immersive views serve different circumstances. The spatial work in [Aura Matrix Studio](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-matrix-studio/) explores seven nested horn torus forms as one way of organising and navigating material. The underlying AI representation and the person's daily interface are separate design questions.

One current spatial scheme has 2,016 facets, or 4,032 addresses when inside and outside are counted. Those are addresses in a proposed geometry, rather than a limit on how many life records a person may hold. The geometry gives an organising language; it does not prove that human understanding fits a fixed map.

## The full Genesis invitation

My invitation to Paul concerns the full [Aura Genesis Protocol](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-genesis-geode-atlas/), rather than a brief introductory demonstration. The proposed intensive programme combines 60 two-hour HBOT sessions with guided reflection, personal records and the developing Truth Engine. The present material includes 30 chapters and a 60-day reading and learning sequence.

HBOT means hyperbaric oxygen therapy. It involves a person in a pressurised environment breathing oxygen under the arrangements appropriate to the equipment and clinical setting. The protocol proposes a mask-based Personal Atmosphere Delivery System. The proposed two-hour programme is a design specification for discussion with qualified providers, rather than a treatment recommendation for every participant.

For Paul, a serious conversation would cover the purpose, time involved, individual suitability, clinical responsibility, equipment, costs, recording, data handling and the ability to stop. Participation remains his personal choice. Access to community work or civic participation does not depend on completing Genesis.

## What the Truth Engine is trying to investigate

The proposed Truth Engine brings together a person's account, deliberately consented truth and lie baselines, physiological signals where appropriate, and a continuing process of interpretation and correction. Its ambition is to improve self-understanding and the quality of the relationship between a person and their AI.

Physiological measurements do not establish an infallible lie detector. Anxiety, memory, health, context and the design of the questions affect interpretation. The current proposal therefore needs research into accuracy, error, calibration and the consequences of a mistaken inference. The person's own explanation remains part of that inquiry. [S28](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s28)

The full protocol envisages camera and microphone recording throughout sessions, including quiet periods, and other sensors where configured. This makes consent and data handling fundamental to the design. A recording made within the programme is not permission for public release. The specification also needs practical arrangements for interruption, emergency exit, withdrawal and the handling of records already created.

## The Geode and its hardware paths

The Geode is the proposed embodied setting for this intensive work. The current development material explores four paths: adapting an existing seated hard-shell chamber; a geopolymer structure; crystalline, fused-quartz or blended material research; and a more distant structure that integrates computing into advanced material.

These paths have different evidence and engineering demands. A pressure vessel for human occupancy involves structural design, fire precautions, oxygen compatibility, ventilation, communication, emergency access, inspection and maintenance. The TGA's hyperbaric fire advisory and the practice of established clinical services are relevant starting references. [S27](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s27) [S29](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s29)

Advanced material and integrated computing ideas belong to the research horizon. They do not establish that a crystalline computing Geode has been built or approved.

## A separate teaching pathway

The teacher training material explores a 60-day capability pathway for helping people work with Aura, AI and increasingly capable systems in civic and community settings. It is a separate role from clinical HBOT practice. A person skilled at facilitating reflection does not thereby become qualified to operate a medical facility.

The local handover needs those roles visible: participant, facilitator, clinician, equipment operator, software maintainer and person responsible for the records. That clarity allows the full ambition to remain intact while people assess the part they are being invited to take.

title: C Hours and reciprocity
content:
C-Hours record freely given human contribution. The intended meaning has always been reciprocal. Earlier AI-assisted material sometimes described them in commercial terms that do not represent the design.

One C-Hour means one verified hour of voluntary human contribution. It has no dollar value, fixed exchange rate, monetary backing or promise of redemption. It is not a transferable currency, an investment, an ownership share or a substitute for wages. The community decides freely how it expresses appreciation and what opportunities it offers.

This definition governs the handover, including where older documents use a different vocabulary. [D03](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents) [D04](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

## What a contribution record does

A contribution record makes useful work easier to see. Someone helps set up an event, assists a neighbour, contributes to a community archive, mentors a learner or takes part in a properly organised working bee. The record describes the activity, time, agreed verification and any permission to share it.

The person is more than the number of hours recorded. A C-Hour does not rank human worth or claim that every kind of work produces an identical outcome. It records a common measure of time while leaving the activity and its circumstances visible.

Reciprocity is a relationship. People may acknowledge each other, invite someone into a learning opportunity, share a meal, offer the use of a resource or support another person's project. Those choices remain voluntary. They do not settle a debt denominated in C-Hours.

## Keep four records distinct

| Record | What it describes | What follows from it |
|---|---|---|
| Contribution time | Verified voluntary human time and the activity involved | Recognition of the contribution |
| Money | Income, payments, grants, expenses and other financial transactions | The actual financial arrangement |
| Ownership | A documented interest in an enterprise or asset | Rights and responsibilities under that arrangement |
| Outcomes | What changed, for whom, and with what evidence | A basis for learning and assessing the work |

A person might have entries in all four. A paid trainer receives an agreed payment, helps an enterprise they partly own, volunteers at a separate gathering and supports a learner whose progress is later recorded. Those facts remain distinguishable. Combining them into one score would obscure how the programme works.

## A local example

Suppose a community film evening involves a paid technician and several volunteers. The technician's payment belongs in the event budget. The volunteers' agreed hours may be recorded as C-Hours. The event's attendance, accessibility, audience responses and financial result belong in its outcome and operating records.

Later, a local host might offer a voluntary thank-you gathering or a supported creative workshop. That is the host's freely chosen contribution to the relationship. It does not establish a conversion table between hours and tickets, food or services.

The same distinction applies to Mutual Futures. An enterprise's capacity to support learning or community activity comes from real resources and decisions. C-Hours help recognise contribution; they do not manufacture those resources or create a claim on the enterprise.

## Verification without making participation burdensome

An initial local record could be simple: who contributed, what happened, when it happened, how long it took, who confirmed it and what may be made public. The activity organiser and contributor would know the process before the work starts.

Corrections need an ordinary route. Someone may forget to log time, disagree about an entry or prefer to keep an activity private. A disputed entry deserves a human conversation and a visible correction history where appropriate. This is a record of shared work, rather than a permanent judgement on someone's character.

There is also a choice about what is worth recording. Informal care and everyday generosity have value even when nobody logs them. Participation in the recording system remains voluntary.

## What this means for the handover

Paul and any local group would be invited to use this reciprocal definition consistently in public explanations, software, grant material and operating agreements. A review of inherited material would identify older references to tokens, trading, cash conversion, redemption or financial backing and correct the explanation at its source.

Where an activity creates a paid role, its pay and conditions deserve their own agreement. Where a resource has a real cost, someone needs to budget for it. Where a programme offers support, the group needs to explain who provides it and how the decision is made.

This lets the reciprocity remain human and freely chosen, while the financial and organisational arrangements remain clear enough to sustain the work.

title: Ready SET shared work and computing
content:
Ready S.E.T. means Sustainable Employment and Training. The proposal gives the local programme a way to organise work, build practical capability and share resources over time.

It is the operating connection between a person's interests, a useful local task, the people able to support it and the resources needed to finish it. The proposed cooperative would have its own members, governance, finances and employed or contracted roles. It is a structure to develop with participants, rather than an organisation already operating all the activities described here.

## Start with the work people actually need

A local team might support an older resident to use a service, organise a film event, maintain shared equipment, help a learner prepare for paid work or document a community project. Each task needs a person responsible, a realistic scope and a way to know it has been completed.

The [Aura disaster resilience work](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-disaster-resilience) proposes a shared working handbook and local team agreements. These would describe how people join, what they take responsibility for, how they raise a concern, and how responsibility passes to someone else. A handbook becomes useful through real practice and correction, rather than by accumulating rules nobody uses.

The cooperative is also a possible intermediary. It could arrange shared equipment, learning support, administration and relationships between small teams that would otherwise repeat the same work. Each service needs an actual provider and budget. Paid responsibility, volunteering and C-Hour recognition remain clearly described.

## The Cultural Intelligence Node

The [Ready S.E.T. Co-op Cultural Intelligence Node](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/ready-set-co-op-cultural-intelligence-node) is the proposal I discussed with Julie Talty. It links local computing, a community living twin, learning, cultural work and shared services.

A node is a place and an organised capability. It could support AI-assisted work, simulation, media production, local records and training. Culture remains with the people and custodians concerned. A computer does not acquire authority over a story because it has been given a copy.

The current computing reference includes a GB200 NVL72-class rack. That is a reference for exploring workloads, power, cooling, space, support and cost. There is no purchased rack or operating data centre established by the proposal. The first useful workload and the people to support it come before choosing the final size of the installation.

Smaller equipment, shared remote services or a staged combination may answer early needs. The same questions apply at each scale: what runs here, who uses it, what information it receives, what it costs and who fixes it when it stops.

## An ordinary Tuesday and a disrupted Tuesday

| Function | Ordinary use | During a disruption |
|---|---|---|
| Local information | Events, services, project records and practical learning | Dated official advice, local service status and verified needs |
| Shared work | Paid tasks, training, volunteering and maintenance | Agreed support tasks within the team's actual capability |
| Computing | Creative production, useful AI tools and simulations | Essential local records and communication, where power and connectivity allow |
| Places and equipment | Workshops, gatherings, accessible support and shared resources | Their agreed role in the local response, with responsible operators |
| Review | Learn from routine delivery and costs | Record gaps and improve preparedness after the event |

The value of the comparison is that preparedness grows from capability people already use. An unfamiliar system introduced during an emergency has a harder job.

## Council and emergency arrangements

Redland's formal disaster arrangements include the Local Disaster Management Group, Local Disaster Coordinator and Local Disaster Coordination Centre. The cooperative would sit within agreed community relationships with those arrangements. It would not acquire their powers through a software platform. [The council integration chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-disaster-resilience/wiki/Council-integration) explains the intended relationship.

An interface to Guardians IMS or another coordination system is a proposed technical and organisational connection. Access, information handling, responsibility and support would need agreement with the system's actual operators.

## What a local start could establish

A useful first version would have a named organising group, a short list of services people want, one host or working location, and a person paid or otherwise explicitly supported to coordinate the work. A basic operating record would show tasks, money, time, equipment, permissions and outcomes.

For Paul, the local leadership role is to help make those relationships durable. The computing node becomes one useful part of a working community system, with the people, purpose and operating responsibilities visible around it.

title: Minjerribah sites and cultural relationships
content:
Minjerribah is home and the starting place for this programme's local expression. The proposed network brings together culture, living, learning, care, making and shared infrastructure across several places. Each place has its own people, history, authority and practical conditions.

I am developing part of this work with a local Indigenous clever man who is Oodgeroo Noonuccal, Kath Walker's, grandson. That relationship matters to the work. It does not make me a cultural authority or establish agreement from every Quandamooka person, family or organisation.

The [multi-site Minjerribah network](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/multi-site-Minjerribah-network) sets out the current proposal. It is a starting point for place-specific agreements, rather than a single agreement covering all land, services and cultural material.

## Different places, different purposes

| Place or proposal | Intended role | Important next question |
|---|---|---|
| 7-Mile | Noonuccal-led living, cultural activity, gardens, making, learning and residencies | Who holds each decision and what land, operating and cultural agreements apply? |
| 82 Claytons Road, Amity | Proposed gift and partnership involving aged care, disability support and Genesis-related research | Is there a willing land and institutional partnership, with suitable service providers? |
| 9 Ballow Road | Proposed Trust Hub and a home for shared working arrangements | What site access and hosting arrangement is available? |
| 10-12 Ballow Road | Sand and Screen Hub for sport, film, learning, gatherings and intergenerational activity | What site, design and community process would carry it? |
| Recovery and support places | Distinct proposals including men's recovery and places supporting women and children | Which qualified organisations and community members would lead each service? |

These proposals have connections, but they are separate commitments. The 9 Ballow Road Trust Hub and the 10-12 Ballow Road Sand and Screen Hub are different concepts. A promise or permission for one does not apply automatically to the other.

## 7-Mile and Indigenous majority ownership

The working commercial proposal for 7-Mile includes a 41/39/20 ownership split that retains an Indigenous majority. The broader direction also includes a purpose-specific not-for-profit structure with Indigenous majority control. The final arrangements would need the participating people's own decisions and proper documentation.

That proposed split belongs to the specified venture. It is not a formula imposed on every site or a claim over Country. The rights and responsibilities connected with Country, cultural knowledge and family relationships are not company assets created by an ownership chart.

The site material includes desktop measurements and early layout ideas. They help people discuss possibilities. Survey, ecology, fire access, servicing, heritage, accommodation and land-use decisions remain separate work. Early capacity sketches are too preliminary to describe as an approved development yield.

## 82 Claytons Road

The [Anglican partnership proposal](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/Anglican-Diocese-82-Claytons-Amity/) explores a gift for generations and a relationship between place, care and local capability. The proposed Athelas role brings aged care, disability support and Genesis-related research into view. [D06](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

Each of these activities has different operating requirements. Accommodation, funded disability services, aged care and health research need their own providers, agreements and support. A land partnership would begin with the actual landholder and institutions involved. The present proposal does not establish a completed gift, operating service or Anglican endorsement.

## Cultural relationships are part of daily practice

The practical questions occur at every step. Who is entitled to tell a story? Who decides whether it is recorded, translated or published? Who sees the original? What happens if a custodian changes a decision? Who is paid for cultural work? How does a young person learn through a relationship with the people concerned?

Those questions connect directly with the screen network, oral history work, living twin and AI tools. A broad consent form cannot answer every later use. A specific record of what was agreed, with whom and for which purpose gives people something concrete to revisit.

## What I would ask Paul to support

The first local step is a conversation with the people actually involved at each proposed place. It would establish interest, priorities, authority and a useful next piece of work. Paul could help connect relevant council officers, cultural organisations, potential service partners and resources where the participants want that support.

The leadership invitation is to help these relationships become workable and properly resourced. The programme's coherence comes from the useful connections between places while each place keeps its own voice and decisions.

title: Culture screens and public participation
content:
Culture is how the programme becomes something people can experience, question and help shape. Music, film, storytelling, local news, sport and shared gatherings create forms of participation that a technical plan alone cannot provide.

This is also the clearest connection with Paul's arts, culture and heritage portfolio and his background as an actor and facilitator. A public conversation about change needs people who understand how a story lands, who is missing from it and how a room becomes willing to participate.

## A local screen and media network

The [Minjerribah Screen and Media Network](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/minjerribah-screen-media-network/) is a proposed system for community communication, creative work, narrative moderation and outreach. It connects screens, phones, cinema and events with people producing and checking the material.

Its proposed workflow is straightforward: a tip or contribution comes in, someone checks it, an editor prepares it, the agreed version is published and broadcast, and the record is archived. Permission, source information and corrections travel with the work. A screen location needs a willing host, equipment, connectivity, maintenance and a clear person to call.

Narrative moderation means making the public story accountable to evidence, context and the people affected. It includes a correction route, a right to respond where appropriate, clear editorial responsibility and room for disagreement. A shared network needs published decisions about these matters, particularly when its participants also work with council or advocate a project.

An early editorial group could develop those arrangements through a small, real programme: local notices, one community story, one practical explainer and a regular correction review. A political position or sponsored item would be identified clearly. A proposed cooperative ownership model would give members an agreed role in the network's governance if they choose to form it.

## The Sand and Screen Hub

The [Ballow Road Sand and Screen Hub](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/ballow-road-sand-screen-hub/) imagines a place where sport, film, learning and intergenerational activity support each other. Public gatherings and a market are among the possible activities. They are future programme ideas. I have not run a market stall under Strange But True.

The hub's usefulness would come from an actual programme, hosts, access, equipment and people to run it. Its place in the system is to connect everyday participation with creative and practical skills. A learner might help make an accessible local film, gain experience with equipment and later take a paid role through the wider work network.

## Grain by Grain and Civilisation of Sand

[Grain by Grain](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/grain-by-grain-documentary/index.html) is a proposed 90-minute, seven-act documentary connecting local infrastructure and material capability with a much larger resilience horizon. It begins with tangible steps around Dunwich and follows the possible development of useful excavation, material testing, production and future settlements.

[Civilisation of Sand](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/civilisation-of-sand/) opens related questions through a simulation and learning world. Builders, resources, material passports and quests let people investigate how systems connect. The documentary and simulation have different jobs: one develops a public story; the other creates a place to explore choices. Neither stands in for engineering evidence.

Both belong in the cultural programme because the proposed future includes enjoyable daily life, creativity, play and belonging. An underground settlement intended for successive generations would need those qualities as deliberately as food, water and power.

## Music and the long public conversation

The i C. infinity music work, including A Protopian Gambit and Straddie Fun, gives the wider programme another language. Songs can carry an invitation, a question or a feeling that people later explore in detail. Their role here is cultural communication, with the factual explanation available alongside it. [D16](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents) [D17](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

The proposed July 2035 gathering brings music and art together with reflection on past, present and future. It gives years of local work a shared public horizon, while each local activity still has its own immediate value.

## Information during a disruption

The same network could relay dated official advice and verified local service information when people need it. This would require a defined publishing process, backup arrangements and clear source attribution. The emergency information role belongs within agreed local disaster relationships.

For the handover, the useful beginning is a small editorial and production team with a real audience and an achievable programme. Paul's contribution could be to help convene that team, strengthen its public relationships and protect the conditions for an open, capable cultural life.

title: P4A law and democratic participation
content:
P4A is the civic and democratic part of the programme. It gives people a way to connect a public claim with its evidence, the decision involved, the people affected and the changes that follow.

The public site is [p4a.xyz](https://p4a.xyz/). The [source repository](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/p4a-xyz-cinema) contains its developing workbench and public examples. It is a proposed movement and participatory architecture, rather than a registered political party or an adopted government system.

## From the 2012 law inquiry to a public workbench

My [Australian Law 2012 collection](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/australian-law-2012-lukes-relevance/index.html) records an early period of investigating how law, institutions and a person's circumstances fit together. The later Constitutional Matrix, Aura and civic work continue that interest in making complex arrangements visible and open to examination.

The thread matters to this handover because the local programme raises public questions as well as operating questions. A transport proposal involves evidence, access, money and public decisions. A community computing node involves information, authority and ongoing cost. A business succession arrangement affects workers and residents as well as its owners.

P4A seeks to give those relationships an intelligible public record. It does not assume that a larger collection of information automatically produces a fair decision.

## What the workbench holds

The present architecture connects public claims and evidence with participation, outcomes, legal memory and change over time. Its Twinkles are structured prompts and perspectives for exploring the subject from several directions. Their purpose is to make the inquiry more accessible and reveal questions a single summary might leave out.

The Redlands example connects the city's ten divisions with local project seeds and dated indicators. National expansion has begun across all eight states and territories, with differing levels of detail. These are working examples of an information structure, rather than evidence that every locality has an established participating group.

A useful local record would let a person ask:

1. What is being proposed, and by whom?
2. What evidence supports it and what remains uncertain?
3. Who has the actual power to decide?
4. What would it cost, who pays, and who benefits?
5. How do affected people contribute or challenge it?
6. What happened after the decision, and what changed?

## Personal and public information

A civic profile is a chosen public representation. It is distinct from the much richer private material someone may keep in a personal Aura. Sharing a view about a local project does not give the project access to a person's health records or private life.

AI can help compare documents, locate provisions, summarise submissions and show conflicting accounts. The source and date remain important. A useful system makes it easy to inspect the original and correct a mistaken interpretation. Earlier descriptions of flawless legal AI exceed what the present tools establish.

## The constitutional horizon

The longer proposal explores a cyber republic and new forms of public representation, with a target of a referendum by 2031 and a visible demonstration around Brisbane 2032. Those dates are ambitions in my programme. There is no official referendum announced through this work. [D15](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

This opens large questions about representation, participation, identity, public authority, deliberation and accountability as AI becomes more capable. They deserve an open argument and a lawful public process. A local workbench supplies a place to learn how people use evidence and participation tools in ordinary decisions before drawing national conclusions.

## The invitation to Paul

I would like Paul to engage directly with P4A: examine its Redlands material, question the proposed roles, and help develop a civic process people would find worth using. His experience with facilitation and applied democracy makes that a substantive invitation.

There are several possible levels of involvement, from a critical conversation to participation in a public trial or a longer political commitment. Each would be stated in its own terms. Joining a discussion does not announce a candidacy or imply agreement with every policy or constitutional proposal.

The local handover would keep this public inquiry connected with practical work. People would have a way to see what is promised, who has accepted responsibility and what is happening as the programme develops.

title: People and public responsibilities
content:
The relationships in this chapter connect the programme with public responsibilities at different levels. I have met Paul Bishop, Peter Mitchell, Julie Talty, Amanda Stoker and Henry Pike at events or in their offices about aspects of the local macro plan. The account of those conversations is mine.

Their public roles help explain why those conversations matter. A meeting, a positive response or a shared interest has a different status from an agreed partnership, funding decision or endorsement of the whole programme. Kevin Rudd and Milton Dick belong to the wider relationship horizon; I am not claiming an existing relationship with either through this handover.

Public roles below are dated to 24 October 2026.

## Paul Bishop: local continuity, culture and convening

Paul represents Division 10, Birkdale and Thorneside, and was first elected to Redland City Council in 2012. His portfolio is Arts, Culture and Heritage. His public profile combines acting with facilitation, co-design, collective impact, applied democracy and ecological sustainability. His listed connections include Arts Evolution, the Queensland Social Enterprise Council and the Placemaking Leadership Council. [S07](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s07) [S08](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s08)

That history helps explain the proposed relationship. He brings experience with public rooms, creative work, institutions and collaborative processes. His arts and heritage responsibilities connect with the screen network, local stories, museum relationships and the proposed hubs. His broader interests connect with Mutual Futures and the participatory work.

Our 2011 meeting gives the invitation a personal beginning. His long council experience gives it a present practical setting. The proposed role still needs a conversation about his interest, capacity and the people who would share the work.

## Julie Talty: environment, local operations and care

Julie is Deputy Mayor and represents Division 6, Mount Cotton and Redland Bay. Her portfolio is Environment and Local Laws. She is also Deputy Chair of the Local Disaster Management Group. Her public background includes teaching, small business and trade qualifications. [S08](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s08) [S09](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s09)

I discussed the Cultural Intelligence Node with her. That proposal connects with environmental information, community capability and the practical operation of services during an ordinary week or a disruption. Her responsibilities also make her relevant to questions about site use, environmental effects and how a proposed activity fits council processes.

Her position as Deputy Mayor is distinct from occasional acting mayor duties performed by other councillors. The legal route to filling a mayoral vacancy is explained in [the mayoral options chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Mayoral-options-and-personal-agency).

## Peter Mitchell: the island's council division and economic development

Peter represents Division 2, Cleveland and North Stradbroke Island. His portfolio is Economic Development. His public background includes small business and community involvement. [S08](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s08) [S10](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s10)

This makes his role relevant across the local programme: business succession, employment, learning, creative activity, tourism, transport and productive infrastructure. Mutual Futures offers a substantive economic conversation that reaches beyond a single capital project.

The island proposals sit within the division he represents. Early discussions with him and the relevant officers could identify existing work, community concerns and the decisions that belong to council or another organisation.

## Amanda Stoker: local representation with federal experience

Amanda's relevance includes her previous federal work and legal background. Her public biography describes growing up with a plumber father and a shop assistant mother, studying arts and law at the University of Sydney on a scholarship, and working four part-time jobs while studying. Her legal experience includes MinterEllison, judicial associate roles with Ian Callinan in the High Court and Philip McMurdo in the Queensland Supreme Court, Commonwealth prosecution and private practice. [S11](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s11)

She represented Queensland in the Senate from 2018 to 2022. Her assistant minister responsibilities included the Attorney-General, Industrial Relations and Women. Her parliamentary work included legal and constitutional affairs and committees concerned with security, integrity, finance, the future of work and other public questions. [S12](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s12)

She was elected Member for Oodgeroo in 2024. Until the change announced today, she was Assistant Minister for Finance, Trade, Employment and Training. On **24 October 2026**, she was appointed Minister for Families, Seniors and Disability Services and Minister for Child Safety and the Prevention of Domestic and Family Violence. Natalie Marr was appointed to the assistant ministry. [S13](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s13)

That shift adds a direct connection with the care, family support, disability and community capability parts of the programme. Her previous work remains relevant to the legal, employment, training and national dimensions. My assessment from our engagement is that she is a confident and supportive asset in the work we have discussed. That is my account of the relationship, rather than a formal ministerial commitment to every proposal here.

## Henry Pike: federal representation, disability and mental health

Henry is the federal Member for Bowman. Since February 2026 his opposition responsibilities have included Shadow Assistant Minister for Disability and the NDIS and Shadow Assistant Minister for Mental Health. [S14](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s14)

Those responsibilities connect with proposed care services, accessible participation, shared wellbeing, workforce capability and the transition towards more capable AI. As an opposition representative, his role includes representation, policy development and scrutiny. It is distinct from a government funding approval.

## Kevin Rudd and Milton Dick: wider avenues to explore

Kevin Rudd returned to Asia Society as its global President and CEO in March 2026 after serving as Australia's Ambassador to the United States. His earlier roles include Prime Minister, Foreign Minister, Member for Griffith and Director-General of the Queensland Cabinet Office. That combination gives a clear reason to explore Asia Society as an avenue for the proposed international dialogue. [S15](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s15)

Milton Dick was elected President of the Inter-Parliamentary Union on 9 October 2026 for a three-year term. His path includes Brisbane City Council, the federal seat of Oxley and the Speakership of the House of Representatives. The IPU connects national parliaments, making it relevant to the proposal for parliamentary exchange and cooperation across different political systems. [S16](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s16)

These are prospective avenues. An introduction would carry a defined request and an accurate account of the local work already under way.

## A shared programme with distinct roles

Paul is the main person I am approaching for local continuity. The wider group offers different responsibilities and relationships. A practical next conversation would ask what each person is interested in, what lies within their role, and which part of the programme has a credible next step. The aim is a working set of relationships with clear commitments, rather than a list of prominent names.

title: Mayoral options and personal agency
content:
I have considered the possibility of standing for Mayor of Redland City if a vacancy creates a by-election before the final part of the present term. I believe this body of work gives me the substance for a serious public case and the capacity to build a winning campaign. That is my assessment of my capacity and the programme, rather than a polling result or an announced candidacy.

My preference is a local leadership arrangement with Paul and other willing people. I want to keep developing the wider architecture, earn a living, travel and build relationships beyond the region. A council position would consume a substantial part of that freedom and attention.

## The date that changes the process

The relevant threshold is **16 March 2027**. The last ordinary Queensland local government election was on 16 March 2024. Under sections 161 and 164 of the Local Government Act 2009, the final part of the term begins on the third anniversary of that election. [S17](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s17) [S18](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s18)

| When the mayoral office becomes vacant | Current route for filling it |
|---|---|
| Before 16 March 2027 | A by-election for mayor |
| From 16 March 2027 to the next ordinary election | Council appoints one of its existing councillors by resolution |

The date the office becomes vacant determines the route. The date on which a later poll could be held is a separate matter. The current statutory framework is the basis for this overview; any actual vacancy would need its circumstances and the law then in force checked.

There is no assumption here that the present mayor will be removed or that a vacancy will occur.

## Acting as mayor and becoming mayor

The Deputy Mayor performs the mayor's functions in the circumstances provided by the Act. Councillors may also perform acting duties at particular times. Seeing Paul, Julie or another councillor representing the mayor at an event does not by itself establish a right to the office after a vacancy.

During the final part of the term, the appointment comes through a council resolution selecting an existing councillor. That gives the existing council a defined role in the outcome. Public relationships and the ability to work with colleagues matter, alongside any individual's interest in serving.

## What a short term would involve

A by-election winner serves the balance of the term, rather than receiving a fresh four-year term. With the next ordinary election in 2028, the remaining period could be around a year, depending on when the vacancy and election occur.

That period would include the duties of the office, council relationships, existing budgets and programmes, public expectations and preparation for the next election. It would offer a platform for local leadership, with a substantial workload and a limited period to establish continuity.

My consideration has included that trade-off. The programme reaches well beyond a council term. Winning office would be one possible way to serve it, with an opportunity cost for the wider work. A handover offers another route if the local people accepting responsibility have a viable arrangement.

## What I want Paul to understand

I am bringing a developed body of work, a long period of investigation and a willingness to make a public case. I am also making a deliberate choice about where my effort is most useful. The preference for a handover comes from the scale and direction of the work and the kind of life I want to retain.

This conversation is not an offer to transfer an electoral mandate. Voters choose a mayor at a by-election; councillors make the appointment provided by the Act during the final part of the term. Any campaign or council appointment would have its own public process.

The practical invitation stands whether or not a vacancy arises. Paul could help convene the local programme in his present role, alongside other councillors and community participants. A durable working group, resources and accepted responsibilities would be useful under any mayoral outcome.

## The immediate decision

The first decision is whether Paul wants to explore that local leadership relationship. From there we could agree the part he would carry, the people to involve, the support required and the way my ongoing role would work. [The handover chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Making-the-handover-work) turns that conversation into a concrete proposed process.
